hero.title:
Get Fluso
for your machine.
hero.subtitle: Choose the app for your device, or sign in from your browser.

platforms.footnote: Windows 10/11 and macOS 13+ (Apple Silicon & Intel). Fluso is also available on iPhone and the web.

steps.quit: If Fluso is already running, quit it first with ⌘Q. The installer can't replace a running app.

place.windows: Run the installer and follow the prompts.

steps.signIn: Open Fluso. Sign in with the same account and your workspace catches up.

install.help: On a different machine? <switch>Switch platforms</switch> above. Trouble installing? Email <email>fluso@premai.io</email>.

guarantee: Signed, notarised, and auto-updating. If the connection drops or your laptop sleeps mid-answer, Fluso preserves the work and continues when it can. Your data stays in your dedicated EU sandbox. By downloading Fluso, you agree to our <terms>terms</terms> and <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

trust.label: Signed installers
trust.body: Mac builds are notarised, Windows builds are signed, and new desktop versions install quietly in the background.

trust.label: EU data boundary
trust.body: Your workspace lives in your dedicated EU sandbox. The desktop app is just the window into it.

trust.label: Syncs on sign-in
trust.body: New machine? Sign in with the same account and your projects, memory and connectors catch up. Sync history shows readable failures and prompts you when reconnect is needed.
